defs.def: a large piece of a solid material that is square in shape and usually has flat sides （方形平面）大块；立方体

ex.t: 我们到达溪边，他们不情愿地往前走。

ex.s: Inhabitants of Boise, Idaho, watched with trepidation earlier this year as the city's oldest, tallest resident moved two blocks.
ex.t: 这家总部位于德克萨斯的公司开发并获得专利了一种挖掘和搬运技术来移动巨大的树木。

defs.def: a tall building that contains flats or offices; buildings that form part of a school, hospital, etc. which are used for a particular purpose （公寓、办公、教学、医院等）大楼；（成组建筑中的）一栋楼房

ex.s: Because it blocks local hospital expansion plans.
ex.t: 因为巨杉树有一百多岁了。

ex.s: In the coming days, we 2___________ (paint) the iron roof of the toilet block that we had been building over the last two months.
ex.t: 在接下来的日子里，我们2___________（粉刷）过去两个月一直在修建的厕所屋顶铁皮。

defs.def: a group of buildings with streets on all sides 四面临街的一方块楼群；街区

ex.s: Because the moon’s body blocks direct radio communication with a probe, China first had to put a satellite in orbit above the moon in a spot   63   it could send signals to the spacecraft and to Earth.
ex.t: 由于月球本体阻挡了与探测器的直接无线电通信，中国必须先在月球上方轨道上的一个___63___能将信号发往航天器和地球的位置部署一颗卫星。

ex.s: Instead of walking a few blocks to pick up a child or the dry cleaning, they send the self-driving minibus.
ex.t: 他们不步行几个街区去接孩子或取干洗衣服，而是派出自动驾驶小巴。

ex.s: It blocks a key protein in the body’s cells that is to for the spread of cold-causing virus.
ex.t: 它阻断了人体细胞中对感冒病毒传播起关键作用的一种蛋白质。

defs.def: the length of one side of a piece of land or group of buildings, from the place where one street crosses it to the next （两条街道之间的）一段街区

ex.s: Consequently, they purchased a block of white marble more than 5 metres in length and 6,000 kilograms in weight.
ex.t: 于是，他们购买了一块长逾5米、重达6000公斤的白大理石料。

defs.def: a large area of land 一大片土地
an area of land for building a house on 房基地；宅基地
a quantity of sth or an amount of time that is considered as a single unit （东西的）一批，一组；（时间的）一段

ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．
ex.t: “时间”和“目的地”的压力是觉察的进一步阻碍。我遇到许多徒步者，他们赶往远处营地，时间刚好够天黑前到达。他们很少想到逛一逛，花点时间看看周围。我问他们看到了什么。“哦，几只鸟，”他们说。他们似乎一心奔着目的地。

defs.def: something that makes movement or progress difficult or impossible 障碍物；阻碍；妨害
a movement that stops another player from going forward 阻挡；拦截

ex.s: She goes down from the block, stops, looks wistfully back,–her daughter stretches her hands towards her.
ex.t: 她从断头台走下，停下，怅然回望——她的女儿向她伸出双手。

defs.def: (in the past) the piece of wood on which a person's head was cut off as a punishment （旧时斩首用的）垫头木

ex.s: Its access was blocked by many people.
ex.t: 9 根据第3段，以下是Petroski博士的观点的是哪一项？

defs.def: to stop sth from moving or flowing through a pipe, a passage, a road, etc. by putting sth in it or across it 堵塞；阻塞

ex.s: •Do not cover or block your smoke detector in any way．
ex.t: •不要以任何方式遮盖或堵塞你的烟雾探测器。

defs.def: to stop sb from going somewhere or seeing sth by standing in front of them or in their way 堵住（某人的路等）；挡住（某人的视线等）
to prevent sth from happening, developing or making progress 妨碍；阻碍
to stop a ball, blow, etc. from reaching somewhere by moving in front of it 拦截，挡住（球、打击等）
to stop light or noise from coming in 挡住，遮住（光线或声音）
to stop yourself from thinking about or remembering sth unpleasant 忘掉，抹去（不愉快的事）

ex.s: Techniques involve blocking, posturing and powerful punching and kicking.
ex.t: 其技术包括格挡、姿势以及有力的拳击和踢腿。
